description: This file defines the Escher class responsible for parsing and loading Escher stream data within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling drawing and shape data in Excel XLS files.

classes.name: Escher
classes.description: Class for parsing and loading Escher stream data related to drawing objects in Excel files.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads Escher stream data, parsing various record types and constructing corresponding objects.

methods.name: readDefault
methods.description: Handles generic record reading when no specific handler is defined.

methods.name: readDggContainer
methods.description: Reads a Drawing Group Container record and its contents.

methods.name: readDgg
methods.description: Reads a Drawing Group record.

methods.name: readBstoreContainer
methods.description: Reads a Blip Store Container record and its contents.

methods.name: readBSE
methods.description: Reads a BSE (Blip Store Entry) record.

methods.name: readBlipJPEG
methods.description: Reads a JPEG image Blip record.

methods.name: readBlipPNG
methods.description: Reads a PNG image Blip record.

methods.name: readOPT
methods.description: Reads an OPT record, which may contain property-value pairs.

methods.name: readTertiaryOPT
methods.description: Reads a TertiaryOPT record.

methods.name: readSplitMenuColors
methods.description: Reads a SplitMenuColors record.

methods.name: readDgContainer
methods.description: Reads a Drawing Container record.

methods.name: readDg
methods.description: Reads a Drawing record.

methods.name: readSpgrContainer
methods.description: Reads a Shape Group Container record.

methods.name: readSpContainer
methods.description: Reads a Shape Container record.

methods.name: readSpgr
methods.description: Reads a Shape Group record.

methods.name: readSp
methods.description: Reads a Shape record.

methods.name: readClientTextbox
methods.description: Reads a ClientTextbox record.

methods.name: readClientAnchor
methods.description: Reads a ClientAnchor record, which contains shape positioning info.

methods.name: readClientData
methods.description: Reads a ClientData record.

methods.name: applyAttribute
methods.description: Applies a method to the internal object if the method exists.

methods.name: readOfficeArtRGFOPTE
methods.description: Reads property-value pairs from OfficeArt RG FOPTE table.
